issues.description: The problem statement explicitly requires calculateTotalPrice to be static (shared across instances), but the solution implements calculateTotalPrice as an instance method. This mismatch between the specification and the provided solution will confuse students about whether calculateTotalPrice should be static and may lead to incorrect implementations or test mismatches.
issues.suggestedFix: Make calculateTotalPrice static to match the problem statement (declare it as public static int calculateTotalPrice(Meal meal)) and update any calls accordingly, or update the problem statement to remove the static requirement for calculateTotalPrice so it matches the solution. Ensure the template and tests (if any) align with the chosen option.
